title: Explorer route screen
responsibility: Connects a framework route to the explorer console and a supplied screen component.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.title
inputs.description: Required page title, followed by the Harness name in the document title.

inputs.name: HarnessScreen.content
inputs.description: Required explorer screen component to render through the console.

outputs.name: HarnessScreen
outputs.description: Explorer console bound to the current route and query beneath /harness. Navigation uses the framework router with the requested history replacement while preserving focus and avoiding automatic page scrolling.
